A recent-activity landing page is a new page idea, not the daily review page itself
Unifying inbox and sessions data is not named in any of the three things
Tracing which files change during work is not in any of the three things
Monorepo backup to the E drive is not one of the three things
Choosing a backup folder on the E drive is not one of the three things
Measuring a worktree for a backup run is not one of the three things
Pruning worktrees to cut repo size is not plainly the closed-worktree review item, which is about merging their commits
A GitHub history prune plan is not one of the three things
A legacy branch for old work is not one of the three things
A Git branching strategy is not one of the three things
A blank-state start template is not one of the three things
Reusing quick-fix worktrees is workflow infrastructure outside the three things
Worktree cleanup in the quick-fix workflow is not one of the three things
Moving worktrees into the worktree folder is not one of the three things, and the exact set is unconfirmed

Alternatives to committing artifacts are not one of the three things
Keeping screenshots out of the repo is not one of the three things
A base set of reusable layouts and styles is design foundation, not one of the three things
Grading foundational components in the library is not one of the three things
Faster voice answers in ext/Session are not named in any of the three things
Mobile tap-to-select for the AI is dev tooling, not the review page or the phone session pages
A Playwright template-change monitor on main is not one of the three things
